Name: Frigidigitation
Description:
You weave your frosty magics into a plethora of icy legerdemain. You create one of the following effects:

- You snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

- You create an instantaneous, harmless effect such as a flurry of snowflakes, a shower of sleet, or a harmless spray of icy mist.

- You chill up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.

- You make frost appear on an object or a surface you touch for 1 minute.

- You freeze the water within a 5-foot cube, provided there are no creatures in it. The water unfreezes in 1 hour.

- You weave a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image of ice or snow that can fit in your hand that lasts for 1 minute.

If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have two of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time, and you can use an action to dismiss any effect it has produced.
